args.text: Hi Ruth, Gideon Sato asks me to email Odile Brandt (odile.brandt@carrowmere.example, Carrowmere) the Hartford incident timeline from #inc-vtg-hartford: first report 10:42 AM, kiosk 1 back 11:03 AM, both lanes back 11:07 AM, all on Aug 3. I haven't sent the email yet. Odile's address is outside pemberline.com, so Ruth Calloway has to approve it first. That applies to drafts too. I've DMed Ruth and will send it once she says yes.

This is the timeline I pulled from #inc-vtg-hartford, all on Aug 3, 2026:
- **First report:** 10:42 AM, with both inbound lanes showing a white screen after badge scan.
- **Kiosk 1 back:** 11:03 AM.
- **Both lanes back:** 11:07 AM.

The channel doesn't give a time for kiosk 2 coming back separately. Your 11:08 AM message says both lanes were working as of 11:07. The times are in the channel's display time, and it doesn't name a time zone. Odile will need that when she matches them to the gateway logs.
